reason: I'd probably use the free first visit if it's a rainy Saturday, but I wouldn't be paying after that. Library storytime and the parks cost nothing, and $13-15 a visit on a $38k budget is a real chunk of the week.
objection: $13 to $15 a visit, plus $45 a month for unlimited, is a lot when the library and parks are free. I only get weekends, so I'd barely use a membership.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price around $8 a visit, or a free-with-purchase deal that makes the $60 pack feel closer to $8 a visit.
